name: Gegenwarten Festival - Alien Frequencies
description: HAU's Gegenwarten Festival presents performances and works exploring alternative frequencies and otherworldly perspectives. The April 2026 edition includes ML Buch's electronic music performance exploring uncanny soundscapes, and multiple performances across HAU venues examining themes of transformation, otherness, and bodies in space. The festival provides a platform for experimental performance art that challenges conventional boundaries between disciplines and explores what it means to be human in an age of technological and ecological transformation.
